description: $x of a covers A and the synthetic T, and projects to the original A alone. The query reads that original token, so probe matches. Read over the reconstructed tokens A T, it would not (engine §7.6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a $x(body)
%conditions matches($x, probe)
%rule body A [+T]
%rule b A [+T] [+T]
%rule c A T
%rule probe A
